d. Rates to be quoted shall be inclusive of all taxes and duties, inclusive of Goods and Service s tax (GST). The scope of work under the subject tender is of indivisible nature and shall be awarded to a single agency only unless specified in the tender document. f. Subsequent to finalization of tender, the work order will be placed after applying the perce ntage variation on variable portion as illustrated below. g.
